turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.reply: Hi — I’m not seeing an order under maya.parker71@hotmail.com right now. Could you send your order number (it should start with SM), or the email used at checkout so I can check it for you? 🙂

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.reply: Hi — normally, orders ship within 1–3 business days, and tracking is usually sent once the label is created 📦 After shipping, delivery typically takes another 4–8 business days. So the usual total is 5–11 business days. If your order includes personalization, the total timeline is 10–16 business days because those need an extra 5 business days of handling. Most orders arrive on the lower end of that range, but if you want, send your order number starting with SM or the checkout email and I can look into your specific order 🙂

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.reply: Once it ships, delivery is usually 4–8 business days with standard shipping 📦🙂 If your order includes personalization, there’s also an extra 5 business days of handling before it ships. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.reply: I totally get wanting your order as soon as possible! Right now, we don’t have an expedited shipping option — we’re only able to offer standard shipping. The good news is, our team works super quickly, so most orders arrive on the faster end of the 4–8 business day shipping window after they leave our warehouse. You can find all the details on our shipping page here: Shipping Info. Let me know if you have any other questions!

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.reply: If tracking never updates, here’s what to do 📦 If the label was just created, it can take about 2–3 business days for tracking to start moving. If it stays stuck longer than that, or if there haven’t been updates for an extended period, the next step is to file a claim here: claims.the storemodern.com You’ll need your order number when you submit it. If you want, send your order number starting with SM and I can help you figure out whether it’s still within the normal window 🙂
